_about: Versions of one study that are listed as separate sources. The counting code and the Bibliography treat each group as one work: primaryUrl is the version shown as the entry, and each alsoCirculatedAs link is listed under it as another version. Matching is by link, so a changed title does not break it.

alsoCirculatedAs.note: Earlier working paper version (Harvard Business School Working Paper 24-013, 2023). Some figures are reported only in the working paper, not in the published abstract.
